Committee of Supply – Head S (Ministry of Manpower)

1,330 of 1,601 sentences in this record
Mr Desmond Choo
MOM workforce reforms

The motion seeks a $100 reduction in Head S, citing MOM reforms including COMPASS and the Platform Workers Act.

  1. s00001 · 2612+2614+2619Mr Desmond Choo — Tampinescontext

    Mr Chairman, I move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head S of the Estimates be reduced by $100." Over the current term of Government, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) has undertaken bold reforms to steer our workforce from crisis to recovery, from downturn to growth.

  2. s00002 · 2612+2614+2619Mr Desmond Choo — Tampines

    We introduced the Complementarity Assessment (COMPASS) framework to ensure foreign talent complements and never displaces our Singaporean core.

  3. s00003 · 2612+2614+2619Mr Desmond Choo — Tampines

    We legislated the world's first Platform Workers Act to protect more than 70,000 workers who have been under-protected for too long.
